evidence.notes: Permission-set-scoped AccessLevel values drive supported SOQL and DML permission checks.
Local metadata-backed describe maps expose loaded standard and project objects.
Local describe results include labels, key prefixes, query/search flags, fields, and record type metadata.
Field describe results use local metadata for picklist entries.
The local LWC record wire serves object-info JSON from the same metadata model.

source.content: AccessLevel scoped = AccessLevel.withPermissionSetId('0PS000000000998'); Database.queryWithBinds('SELECT Id, Hidden__c FROM Account', new Map<String,Object>(), scoped);
Record wire and getObjectInfo tests assert local field labels, object info, and values from storage.
